verdict.rationale: Verbatim guidance text was extracted from several canada.ca CRA pages (registration overview, e-services, EFILE, agency home). That indicates the public reading surface serves readable, server-rendered content to an automated fetcher. The canada.ca probe also got a plain HTTP 302 response rather than a challenge page, so no bot wall or CAPTCHA appears in front of the platform. Missing for 10: an explicit probe recording HTTP 200 on a guidance page under a declared agent user agent, direct confirmation that no CAPTCHA or JS-only shell sits in front of the pages, and independent corroboration.
